But the user says "start Docker on window using docker start." That seems ambiguous. They might want to start Docker Desktop service. But the tool can only run commands via os.system. We can attempt to start Docker service via "net start com.docker.service". Or maybe they want to start Docker containers. But no container specified. So we can ask clarification.
